method: Rust release thin-LTO, no target-cpu override for these subsystem kernels; pinned CPU2 during parent-coordinated quiet window.32 warmup calls then7 alternating-order batches; count/round stored with each probe. Medians are repeated batch means, not per-request percentiles or confidence intervals. Actual snapshots replayed by parent from recent VPSgames, then loaded here with snapshot history/repetition reset; see corpus metadata. No additional compilation or timings running.

experiments.finding: Draw-material checks borrow both existing army slices instead of cloning two Vecs; predicate/order/empty-side behavior preserved.
experiments.limitations: Not used inside src/search.rs. Opening result is a per-query API kernel, not whole-search saving. Existing draw tests plus full parent checks cover behavior.

experiments.finding: BoardPosition::from_state reads borrowed lengths and extends borrowed armies into the single necessary owned snapshot Vec. Session snapshot DTO piece enumeration also borrows.
experiments.limitations: Owned snapshot vector/DTO strings remain necessary; no search hot-path claim. Both snapshot orders and serde representation unchanged.

experiments.finding: Validate BoardPosition once, place directly into a new Board, and restore position once; removes full-board rehash/repetition reseed for every piece.
experiments.limitations: Snapshot loading only. State is new, so restore cache-invalidating fixes in PR209 are not required for this optimization. Seeded history/repetition is snapshot semantics.

experiments.finding: Generated Standard Free Eagle ranges skip full route-list regeneration only on trusted unrecorded application. Ordinary FE ranges are NoJump; short matching multi-leg prefixes have empty intermediate squares. Checked destination-only route normalization and explicit paths unchanged.
experiments.limitations: Kernel old arm emulates existing normalization via public single-piece generation, then trusted apply, so includes public generation-wrapper overhead. Do not equate 98% FE fixture saving to whole-search speedup. Exact legacy first-match normalization tested on every generated Standard FE move in 128 seeded sparse/dense boards, both colors; also 96 corner/center blocker fixtures, board/hash/draw/repetition/undo parity.

experiments.status: implemented; strictly avoids full timeline copies
experiments.finding: Added borrowed effective_move_at(index), used for recorded_evals last/next, replacing clone of entire effective timeline. Trunk prefix/branch/setup ownership unchanged.
experiments.limitations: Timing isolates cloning versus two indexed references, excludes DTO formatting/check/legal-generation. Full timeline cloning remains where owned timeline export/rebuild requires it. Trunk/branch/setup edge lookup regression passes. Synthetic records have empty iteration_timings; actual telemetry-bearing record clones may cost more. No entire-session latency claim.

experiments.finding: Measured full canonical hash recompute versus existing cached hash as a ceiling for non-search incremental hashing. Search make/unmake already uses incremental hash.
experiments.limitations: Cached-hash access is not an implementation of canonical move effects or non-search incremental updates. Shared effects across capture rules/simulation/application is an invasive rewrite requiring detailed exotic-route parity. No production change or whole-search gain claimed. External checked make occurs once per played/root move rather than per search node, limiting whole-agent benefit of the measured ~1.4us full-opening hash cost.

experiments.finding: Measured arithmetic piece_key reduction across real current pieces versus a precomputed key list for those exact piece/square identities.
experiments.limitations: This key list omits real identity-to-form-table indexing, misses, memory pressure and maintenance; it is an optimistic cache upper bound, not a production bounded-Zobrist implementation. Full 303x2x2x1296x8 table is 12,566,016 bytes before origin metadata; search already only hashes changed pieces.

experiments.finding: Borrowed all-draw-class scan tested on 804 Kings versus precomputed zero nonqualifying-count query. Opening borrowed predicate short-circuits in ~1ns here.
experiments.limitations: Count prototype ignores update/invalidation cost, extra board state and editor paths; fixture is worst case for a scan and is not a representative material distribution. No src/search.rs draw-material query calls; no search-time benefit established.

experiments.finding: Prototype emits 7-byte header +8 bytes per piece preserving type, origin, coordinates, color, promoted flag. Compared serialization with TSFEN and measured opening byte sizes.
experiments.limitations: No decoder/versioning/endianness contract/malformed-input validation or end-to-end I/O/training bottleneck measured. Existing text interchange unchanged. Write-only kernel cannot justify changing persisted public formats.

experiments.finding: Repeated 64/512-ply two-King reversible sequences compare replay from original state with clone of a state checkpoint plus last32 plies; hashes, repetition_count and history length agree.
experiments.limitations: GameState clone preserves repetition/history here, unlike BoardPosition reload. This is not an integrated DebugTool checkpoint cache, branch invalidation/memory budget or GUI latency measurement. Actual exotic-route replay parity and persisted trunk metadata remain needed. Keeping many full GameState checkpoints naively duplicates history prefixes; retention budget or shared immutable history needs design. Prototype stores only one checkpoint per length.

experiments.status: measured naive iterator prototype rejected; broader idea remains possible
experiments.finding: Compared VirtualBoard::get_pieces_by_color Vec materialization followed by attack_utils candidate-count filtering with borrowed base-army iteration, moved/promoted overlay and removed-victim predicates, then the same candidate-count filtering. Query changes through all1296 squares and is blackboxed. On opening+6VPSsnapshots, both colors, candidate counts agree at100sampletargets percase. The borrowed pipeline regresses13/14 median color-position cases; 6VPS-only subset regresses11/12. Do not ship this prototype.
experiments.limitations: Kernel-only and different return shapes: no owned Vec is needed by the caller in the borrowed arm. It measures candidate prefilter counts, not full attack reachability or early exits; no production BoardLike rewrite, ancestor composition or heavy exotic-capture overlay coverage. One ordinary generated move is overlaid per position. This demonstrates that extra per-attacker filtering can offset removed bulk Vec clones; it does not reject every optimized visitor/overlay design. Prior whole-search CPU ratio1.01508 interval0.98089..1.06270 also did not establish a gain.

experiments.finding: Explicit move-success result removes quiet-success versus failure ambiguity in public Option<Position> result. Current checked callers often compare side-to-move to detect success.
experiments.limitations: No algorithmic work removed by changing result enum alone; changing every admission caller for a speculative nanosecond gain is unwarranted. No move-result API change included.

experiments.finding: Checked multi-leg admission already validates whole routes before mutation; trusted malformed-input failure is outside generated-move contract. PR209 adds promotion correctness checks.
experiments.limitations: Transactional effect records/validated-move tokens need an API design and correctness project. Board-clone transaction would add substantial work; no speed claim or new implementation.

experiments.finding: setup_initial_position replaces board/caches/hash but intentionally retains turn/history/progress state in current implementation. Source census found79 references including tests.
experiments.limitations: Changing reset semantics is behavioral/API work, not a measured speed optimization. No reproduced production failure or reset change in this patch.

experiments.finding: set_current_turn is a low-level hash-aware toggle. Search null-move production path explicitly toggles at lines3659/3671, with separate repetition handling; automatic reset would break intended search state.
experiments.limitations: An editor-specific reset wrapper may improve API clarity but offers no measured speedup. Existing method unchanged; null-move history behavior preserved.

corpus_note: Six latest VPS-derived board positions only, sampled plies24,701,161,1400,420,931; threeWhite/threeBlack. Kernel loading resets move history/repetition to snapshot semantics. Source-game metadata kept by parent corpus.
